scope: Native H03 Task 2 engine context for the first bench pair

entry_points.initializer_contract: Set the field in rbm_h03_target_engine.target when the profile declares the bound. Zero selects legacy RX for existing profiles. The other four profile symbols already populate the descriptor.

can0_configuration.status: Stock ROM and live register pattern. Actual oscillator and bit timing reserved for measurement.

bosch_tx.t4_clock_basis: 40 MHz nominal CPU divided by 512, 12.8 us per T4 tick. Periods are TX attempts.

independent_admission.input: Qualified TML0, matching sensor epoch and bounded snapshot age
Live CAN grant and admitted setup generation
independent_admission.source: Existing H03 CAN owner, engine feed and RX

independent_admission.provider: 0x804887 must differ from OEM service mode 4; FCNT1 at 0x8007E2 and programming gate at 0x80801C must be zero
Shared chery DTC current[3] projected to E02B with CAN ownership and clock state

provenance.qualifier: FA7B=0xFF represents absent independent coolant in the CAN-only profile. Toyota supplies its protected fallback. Existing qualifier owns FD10.12 and E026.1. Lost CAN admission inhibits history by bench policy. No auxiliary E02B flags or absolute engine load are inferred. See docs/toyota-integration.md.

runtime_bounds.basis: (2 * 16 ms + 4 ms arbitration margin) / 2 us. Raw expires at equality. Retained RPM expires at (18000 + 1) * 3 us = 54003 us from its conservative capture date.
Two nominal 5 ms H03 TOP10 phase increments. Existing RX configuration allows at most 30000 us. Applies to consecutive polls and sensor snapshot age. See docs/lfj8-h03-output-adapter.md.

runtime_bounds.status: Engineering upper bound with 1 us lower bound
runtime_bounds.basis: Conservative range about 2 us nominal. Lower bound is one qualified TML0 tick, corresponding to classic CAN at 1 Mbit/s. Compare elapsed CAN and TML0 with bracket and one-bit quantization slack.
Limit early timestamp uncertainty around CAN samples and mailbox reads in the critical section. Clock failures, wide brackets, contradictory deltas and missed polls enter drain/warm-up.

composition_against_main.candidate_capacity_note: Includes only placed known sections. The 2084 bytes of aggregate nominal free space do not establish final capacity in each window or ownership.

memory.abi: New feed-target uint8_t occupies former alignment padding. Existing M32R RAM inventory stays 2816 bytes (control 1132, communication 608, workspace 1076), measured by the repository checker.

stack_bytes_from_disassembly.note: Context and feed run sequentially. The 200 B sum excludes application frames, downstream clock/MMIO calls and IRQ nesting; it is not a complete stack bound.
